The issuer demonstrates solid operational profitability and liquidity, evidenced by an EBIT margin of ~17.5% ($1,236M on $7,080M revenue) and a strong current ratio of 2.19x ($5,511M / $2,513M). However, a high leverage profile with a total liabilities-to-assets ratio of 67.4% ($5,722M / $8,495M) and negative retained earnings (-$1,846M) indicate past financial stress or aggressive capital structure, constraining the rating to the lower investment-grade tier.

DECISION: BBB-
